name: dsh-moodio
description: Agent tools for music emotion analysis: valence/arousal plus attack (texture) and scale (grandeur), keeping 悲壮 distinct from 悲伤. Ships a self-contained Python analyzer.

scripts.test:python: python -X utf8 python/tests/validate_calibration.py && python -X utf8 python/tests/test_emotion_taxonomy.py && python -X utf8 python/tests/test_texture.py && python -X utf8 python/tests/test_four_axis.py && python -X utf8 python/tests/test_batch.py && python -X utf8 python/tests/validate_directionality.py
scripts.test:fast: node test/offline.test.mjs && python -X utf8 python/tests/validate_calibration.py && python -X utf8 python/tests/test_emotion_taxonomy.py && python -X utf8 python/tests/test_texture.py && python -X utf8 python/tests/test_four_axis.py && python -X utf8 python/tests/test_batch.py
